headline: Last session: Sensex fell 289 points and Nifty slipped as inflation concerns weighed on Indian markets.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on investor sentiment in the last trading session.
Foreign fund inflows and lower crude oil prices supported early-week market momentum.
PSU Banks led sectoral gains during the weekly market rally.
Global tech developments and concerns surrounding Nvidia influenced overall market sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex dropped 289 points and Nifty slipped in the previous session.
NIFTY50 and SENSEX extended gains for the third consecutive week despite the late-week pullback.
Microsoft announced full service restoration following a global tech outage.
Logistics firm V-Xpress announced building key logistics hubs in Karnataka.
summary: In the last trading session, Indian equity markets closed lower as inflation concerns pushed the Sensex down by 289 points. Despite the retreat on Friday, benchmark indices extended their rally for the third straight week, boosted by PSU banks and strong foreign inflows earlier in the week. Markets are closed today for the weekend and will resume trading on Monday, 16 November.
